quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on his expectations for his second NBA season
quotes.excerpt: to be a guy that everybody could count on. I think the biggest thing would be consistent.
quotes.quote: To be a guy that everybody could count on. I think the biggest thing would be consistent. I think Tyronn Lue is asking a lot for me and James Harden is expecting a lot for me. So, to be a guy that is consistent on both ends and accountable.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown says his focus for his second season is consistency and accountability. He notes that Tyronn Lue and James Harden are expecting a lot from him this year.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on mentoring a 19-year-old teammate
quotes.excerpt: As long as he plays with confidence, we going to live through the growing pains.
quotes.quote: First, we got to start he is a hell of a player. So just telling him to be confidence. As long as he plays with confidence, we going to live through the growing pains. He is only 19 years old, so there is going to be ups and downs, but the potential he has and the talent that he has right now, he is going to be a hell of a player, so we just trying to build off of that.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown on his young teammate: As long as he plays with confidence we are going to live through the growing pains. He is only 19 years old so there is going to be ups and downs.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on his recovery from a training camp injury
quotes.excerpt: It was tough to see him go down in training camp when we was doing our drills.
quotes.quote: It was tough to see him go down in training camp when we was doing our drills. And just to be able to be here every day, I come in early and I get to see him do his rehab and everything. He was pushing his body to the limit so he can come back and I commend him on it. It is tough being out and having to fight back from an injury.
quotes.social_post: Norman Powell commends a teammate for his work ethic during injury rehab: He was pushing his body to the limit so he can come back and I commend him on it.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on expanding his offensive game to the perimeter
quotes.excerpt: Whatever the game opens up and happens, that is what I am going to take.
quotes.quote: Whatever the game opens up and happens, that is what I am going to take. Regardless if it is a mid-range shot, a three, a dunk, a layup, a pass. Whatever the game presents to me at that moment I am probably going to take it. I do love getting there to my spot and rising up, so I am just going to have to see as the season comes.
quotes.social_post: Norman Powell on his offensive approach this season: Whatever the game presents to me at that moment I am probably going to take it.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on Isaiah Hartenstein as the starting center
quotes.excerpt: He can switch one through five and he can run the floor.
quotes.quote: A lot of versatility. He can switch one through five and he can run the floor. I honestly I think he is one of the best big men in the league, so he is up there with me. Honestly, you have him running one side, me running on the other side, I love our chances. He brings a lot to the table and he protects the rim a lot as well.
quotes.social_post: Norman Powell is high on Isaiah Hartenstein: I honestly think he is one of the best big men in the league. He brings a lot to the table and he protects the rim a lot as well.

quotes.speaker: Norman Powell
quotes.summary_phrase: Norman Powell on the need for defensive aggression
quotes.excerpt: We got to go out there throw the first punch and we can't just allow the teams.
quotes.quote: We got to go out there throw the first punch and we can't just allow the teams to put forth their effort and we just allow them to have fun out there. We got to put up some resistance and make them have a tough night. We didn't lock in on a game plan a lot last year and we didn't guard to our best abilities.
quotes.social_post: Norman Powell says the Clippers need a shift in defensive intensity: We got to go out there throw the first punch. We did not lock in on a game plan a lot last year and we did not guard to our best abilities.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the challenge of playing against a veteran-heavy team
quotes.excerpt: It is going to be a different look for those guys, a different look for us.
quotes.quote: It is going to be a different look for those guys, a different look for us. Isaiah Hartenstein is a great player and you got Zach LaVine, Domantas Sabonis, and so they got a really good team. You got Monte Morris coming off the bench, you got Evan Mobley starting, you got Evan Mobley starting with size and so it is going to be a tough team to play.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue previews the challenge of facing a veteran-heavy opponent: It is going to be a tough team to play.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on his coaching philosophy for the season
quotes.excerpt: It is my job to come in every day, make sure we give our guys confidence.
quotes.quote: It is my job to come in every day, make sure we give our guys confidence, give them the freedom to play, play the right way. And I think we can overachieve. That has kind of been our model since training camp since day one. Our goals that we set, personal goals for our team goals, and so we are going to try to make those goals come true.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on his coaching philosophy: It is my job to come in every day, make sure we give our guys confidence, give them the freedom to play, play the right way. And I think we can overachieve.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on Isaiah Hartenstein's role as a rim protector
quotes.excerpt: It helps Domantas Sabonis get downhill, throw the lob, get to his floaters.
quotes.quote: It helps Domantas Sabonis get downhill, throw the lob, get to his floaters. We got a lob threat now, guys are pulling in and tagging, now you got corner skips, opening up more three-point attempts. And so I think it will be good for us. I think being able to outrun most centers in transition, so now centers are cross-matched.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue explains the offensive benefits of having Isaiah Hartenstein: We got a lob threat now, guys are pulling in and tagging, now you got corner skips, opening up more three-point attempts.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the benefits of preseason experimentation
quotes.excerpt: It is actually helped us, I think, because now you get a chance to see different combinations.
quotes.quote: It is actually helped us, I think, because now you get a chance to see different combinations, what works well together, and what you need to do. After those first two games, we kind of see what we need to do. So that is what we are going to do opening night. Having 15 guaranteed contracts, it is a tough debate between Cam Whitmore, Blake Griffin, and Grady Dick, and just glad to have Cam Whitmore back.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue discusses roster decisions: Having 15 guaranteed contracts, it is a tough debate between Cam Whitmore, Blake Griffin, and Grady Dick, and just glad to have Cam Whitmore back.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the team's defensive identity
quotes.excerpt: We got to be small, but we got to be tough. We got to try to turn teams over.
quotes.quote: We got to be small, but we got to be tough. We got to try to turn teams over. We got to trap teams, rotations, like everything has to be on point defensively to create turnovers and get out in transition. So we got to be able to use our speed. Brandon Ingram was an All-Star last year, Darius Garland has been an All-Star, but when we get Brandon Ingram back, we are going to have a chance to be a special team.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on the defensive identity: We got to be small, but we got to be tough. We got to try to turn teams over. Everything has to be on point defensively to create turnovers and get out in transition.
